category_edits.rationale: Use 90% current GRU state and 10% normalized recency-weighted pooling with a five-step half-life at each causal prefix. This changes the existing fully pooled readout while preserving the backbone, scoring, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports this same model class, keeping training and inference consistent across all four datasets.

response.change_summary: Replace full recency pooling with a 90/10 blend of current recurrent state and causal recency pooling in each category model.
